{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.number }}-${{ github.event.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

on:
  push:
    # branches: [ "master" ] # Run after merging into the "master" target
    paths: # Run only if files relevant to CI have changed (i.e. not bench, contrib, doc, examples, utils or submodule folders)
      - '.flake8'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - 'MANIFEST.in'
      - 'Makefile'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'requirements*.txt'
      - 'setup.py'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tables/**'

  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ] # Run in PRs targeting the "master" branch
    types: # Avoid low-impact events like "edited" or "labeled"
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
    paths:
      - '.flake8'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - 'MANIFEST.in'
      - 'Makefile'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'requirements*.txt'
      - 'setup.py'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tables/**'
  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PACKAGE: tables

jobs:

  sdist:
    name: Create sdist
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        name: Install Python
        with:
          python-version: 3.x
      - name: Ubuntu library headers
        run:  |
          sudo apt update
          # Keep in sync with "Prerequisites" in User's Guide.
          DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt install -y --no-install-recommends libblosc-dev libbz2-dev libhdf5-dev liblz4-dev liblzo2-dev libsnappy-dev libzstd-dev zlib1g-dev
      - name: Source distribution
        run: |
          pip install build
          python -m build --sdist
      - name: Save source distribution
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: tables-sdist
          path: dist/*.tar.gz


  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.x"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install lint dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install flake8 isort black packaging
          if [ -f requirements-lint.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements-lint.txt; fi

      - name: Check dependency constraints are in sync
        run: python ci/check_requirements_sync.py

      - name: Lint (flake8)
        run: |
          python -m flake8 --version
          python -m flake8 --count --show-source --statistics ${PACKAGE}

      - name: Lint (isort)
        run: |
          python -m isort --version
          python -m isort --check ${PACKAGE}

      - name: Lint (black)
        run: |
          python -m black --version
          python -m black --check ${PACKAGE}


  build:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.python }} ${{ matrix.numpy }} ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: sdist
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -l {0}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-15-intel, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        # Keep in sync with ``project.classifiers`` in ``pyproject.toml``.
        python: ['3.11', '3.12', '3.13', '3.14']
        numpy: ['stable']
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python: '3.14'
            numpy: 'dev' # Extra build: NumPy dev with latest Python

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        submodules: true
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python }}
      uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@be893c923ea9cf1cf7cd510fbdde27c7e18cbdcb # v4.1.0
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
        auto-update-conda: true
        channels: conda-forge
        channel-priority: strict
    - name: Install compilers
      if: runner.os != 'Linux'
      run: |
        conda install c-compiler cxx-compiler
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        # Keep in sync with
        # "Prerequisites" in User's Guide,
        # ``build-system.requires`` in ``pyproject.toml``.
        conda install -q bzip2 hdf5 lzo zlib pip
        python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
    - name: Reinstall NumPy dev
      if: ${{ matrix.numpy == 'dev' }}
      run: |
        python -m pip install --force-reinstall --index-url https://pypi.anaconda.org/scientific-python-nightly-wheels/simple numpy
    - name: Python and NumPy version
      run: |
        echo "$(python --version) ($(python -c 'import os, sys; print(os.path.abspath(sys.executable))'))"
        echo "NumPy $(numpy-config --version)"
    - name: Get source distribution
      uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
      with:
        name: tables-sdist
    - name: Installation
      run: |
        python -m pip install -v tables-*.tar.gz
    - name: 'Run test'
      continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.numpy == 'dev' }} # Do not abort job if NumPy dev fails
      run: |
        mv tables _tables
        python -Werror -m tests.test_all -v
        pt2to3 -h
        ptrepack -h
        ptdump -h
        pttree -h


  build_cblosc:
    name: Sdist with cblosc2
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: sdist
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -l {0}

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        submodules: true
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@be893c923ea9cf1cf7cd510fbdde27c7e18cbdcb # v4.1.0
      with:
        auto-update-conda: true
        channels: conda-forge
        channel-priority: strict
    - name: Install compilers
      if: runner.os != 'Linux'
      run: |
        conda install c-compiler cxx-compiler
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        # Keep in sync with "Prerequisites" in User's Guide,
        # ``build-system.requires`` in ``pyproject.toml``.
        conda install bzip2 hdf5 lzo zlib blosc c-blosc2 pip setuptools packaging py-cpuinfo "numpy>=2" cython numexpr
    - name: Get source distribution
      uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
      with:
        name: tables-sdist
    - name: Installation
      run: |
        python -m pip install -v tables-*.tar.gz --no-deps
    - name: Python blosc2 wheel or conda pkg is not installed
      run: |
        ! conda list | grep -E '^(python-)?blosc2'
    - name: 'Run test'
      run: |
        mv tables _tables
        python -Werror -m tests.test_all -v
        pt2to3 -h
        ptrepack -h
        ptdump -h
        pttree -h",
  "rationale": "The lint job reinstalls flake8, isort, black, packaging (and requirements-lint.txt) from PyPI on every run using pip, with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) is supported by observational evidence reporting a modest aggregate VM-time benefit and by a measured fork experiment that added actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on pyproject.toml. Prerequisites hold: repeated pip fetching is measurable, no equivalent cache exists, and the cache input is the dependency manifest (pyproject.toml). Adding the cache step to the lint job preserves all build/test coverage and required checks, changes nothing else, and introduces no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
